Yin-Yin is a Non-Playable Character (NPC) in the Candy Crash storyline.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content:
In-game, Yin-Yin's first and only appearance is in the Brave Halloween 2019 Vortex Dungeon, Candy Crash.

Yin-Yin's unit release was announced in Episode 49's Brave Exclusives section of the Brave News Channel.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content: - As mentioned in Episode 49 of the Brave News Channel, Yin-Yin's character design was inspired by the Jiangshi, also known as the Chinese "hopping" zombie, which is a type of reanimated corpse in Chinese legends and folklore.

==Debut Appearance==
In-game, Yin-Yin's first and only appearance is in the Brave Halloween 2019 Vortex Dungeon, Candy Crash.

Yin-Yin's unit release was announced in Episode 49's Brave Exclusives section of the Brave News Channel.

==Trivia==
*As mentioned in Episode 49 of the Brave News Channel, Yin-Yin's character design was inspired by the Jiangshi, also known as the Chinese "hopping" zombie, which is a type of reanimated corpse in Chinese legends and folklore.
